title.value: Tech Talks Daily: CKEditor and the Reality of Supporting Developers Across Every Tech Stack

summary.value: Guest on Tech Talks Daily (51K monthly listeners) - exploring what it really takes to support developers across every tech stack and why CKEditor's open architecture approach matters for developer experience at scale.

value.description: Tech Talks Daily: CKEditor and the Reality of Supporting Developers Across Every Tech Stack

content.value:
What we talked about

Tech Talks Daily with Neil C. Hughes reaches 51,000 monthly listeners across developers, tech leaders, and enterprise decision-makers. The conversation covered the operational reality of supporting a rich-text editor that's integrated into hundreds of frameworks, CMSes, and custom applications worldwide.

  • Supporting developers at scale - what "developer support" actually means when your users span vanilla JS, React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, Drupal, and dozens of other stacks. The documentation, tooling, and community infrastructure that makes it work.
  • Open architecture as a developer experience choice - why CKEditor 5's plugin-based, framework-agnostic architecture isn't just a technical decision. It's a developer experience philosophy: integrate everywhere, own nothing you don't have to.
  • CKEditor AI and the next chapter - how AI features fit into an editor that already lives inside someone else's application, and the constraints that makes enterprise AI harder than most demos show.
